tests/test_data_integrity_temporal_consi.docstring:
Comprehensive Regression Test Suite for Data Integrity and Temporal Consistency.
Covers Tests 1 through 15 specified in the Phase 2 integrity audit requirements:
- Referential integrity of encounter_id and patient_id across all tables
- Lab patient/encounter association and null-safety
- Treatment provenance rules and evidence_ids preservation
- Encounter lifecycle and non-zero duration semantics
- Event scoping (in-encounter vs post-encounter boundaries)
- Causal event ordering
- Complete journey context propagation
- 10-patient and 100-patient full scale simulation verification
- Deterministic reproducibility across repeated seeded runs

tests/test_pubmed_treatment_architecture.docstring:
Comprehensive Verification Tests for Refactored Medical Knowledge & Simulation Rule Architecture.

Validates:
A. PubMed treatment retrieval (Condition -> MedicalKnowledgeBase -> PubMed -> Candidates)
B. PubMed provenance (source='pubmed_evidence', genuine evidence_ids)
C. No fake evidence (No fabricated PMIDs)
D. YAML independence (Medical treatment retrieval does not depend on deleted YAML treatment blocks)
E. Simulation rules execution across all 5 departments (Clinical, Pharmacy, Lab, Rad, Finance)
F. State transitions and allergy safety check on PubMed candidates
G. Patient journeys and cross-department workflows
H. Offline PubMed cache determinism
